symptoms.symptom: The appliance is not cooling, the displays and lighting are lit.

causes.label: Showroom mode is switched on.
remedies: Switch off the appliance. Page 15
Wait 2 minutes.
Switch the appliance back on. Page 15
Wait 1 minute and then hold down super (Refrigera-
tor compartment) until 4 audible signals sound.
After a short time, check whether your appliance is
cooling.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 26: "Showroom mode is switched on."

symptoms.symptom: The refrigeration unit is switching on more frequently and for longer.

causes.label: The appliance has been opened frequently.
remedies: Do not open appliance door unnecessarily.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 26: "The appliance has been opened frequently."

causes.label: External ventilation openings are covered up.
remedies: Remove any obstructions from in front of the external ventilation openings.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 26: "External ventilation openings are covered up."

causes.label: Not a fault. Modern refrigeration machines switch on more frequently and have different power levels to cool more efficiently.
remedies: Remove any obstructions from in front of the external ventilation openings.
Install the appliance as far away as possible from heating elements, cookers and other heat sources.
Avoid prolonged exposure of the appliance to direct sunlight.
Only open the appliance door as briefly as necessary.
Allow hot food and drinks to cool down first before storing in the appliance.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 26: "Not a fault. Modern refrigeration machines switch on more frequently and have different power levels to cool more efficiently."

symptoms.symptom: A layer of frost forms on the back wall of the refrigerator compartment.

causes.label: Not a fault. Modern refrigeration machines ensure a more even temperature in the refrigerator compartment. The back wall of the refrigerator compartment is defrosted automatically at regular intervals.
remedies: Only open the appliance door as briefly as necessary.
Pack the food airtight or cover it.
Allow hot food and drinks to cool down first before storing in the appliance.
Always leave some space between the food and the interior walls.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 27: "Not a fault. Modern refrigeration machines ensure a more even temperature in the refrigerator compartment. The back wall of the refrigerator compartment is defrosted automatically at regular intervals."

symptoms.symptom: All temperature displays and "alarm" light up.

causes.label: A sensor is defective.
remedies: Call customer service.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 27: "A sensor is defective."

symptoms.symptom: The set temperature is not reached.

causes.label: The freezer compartment door was open for a long time. The evaporator (refrigeration unit) in the NoFrost
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 28: "The freezer compartment door was open for a long time. The evaporator (refrigeration unit) in the NoFrost"

symptoms.symptom: Fully automatic defrosting no longer works.

causes.label: system is heavily iced up. Requirement: Store the frozen food well insulated in a cool place.
remedies: Switch off the appliance. Page 15
Disconnect the appliance from the power supply. Unplug the power plug or switch off the circuit breaker in the fuse box.
Call customer service.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 28: "system is heavily iced up. Requirement: Store the frozen food well insulated in a cool place."

symptoms.symptom: The temperature differs greatly from the setting.

causes.label: Various causes are possible.
remedies: Switch off the appliance. Page 15
Switch the appliance back on after approximately
5 minutes. Page 15 If the temperature is too warm, check the temperature again after a couple of hours.
If the temperature is too cold, check the temperature again on the following day.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 28: "Various causes are possible."

causes.label: The water contained in warm and humid air condenses on the colder surfaces of the appliance.
